blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Injured Boholano basketball player Horrace Morata was deeply touched by the outpouring of support from generous donors who want nothing more than to see him recover from his injury and return to the hardcourt. On Thursday night, October 8, Morata, a rookie player for the Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs, received an […]...
